method: ci-lint local-gate first-pass; paginated GitHub REST GET; ci-minimal.yml for fbuild, ci.yml elsewhere; earliest observed workflow-run cohort
limits: Selected workflow only; does not establish all-workflow or native-lane success.
Merged PRs since the start date; seven live scans are not an atomic fleet snapshot.
Strict GATE-004 excludes PRs without matching runs; the companion includes them as unknown. All old snapshots remain historical.
Earliest observed cohort, not unobserved pushes: an earlier head with no workflow run cannot be reconstructed.
Same-head timestamp ties stay together; ambiguous heads, incomplete metadata, initial cancellation and overwritten first attempts remain unknown.
Known-outcome rate excludes unknowns and must be read with evidence coverage. Observed trailers are not validated attestations.
Report preserves the policy default 80% GATE-004 target; the migration goal remains 100%.
